note: A synthetic client (Slice 116 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: We make premium dog food and sell it through pet stores. We want to know whether a direct subscription in Denver is worth testing.

answers.common.decision: Whether to fund a Denver test; the founders decide.
answers.common.materials: Denver metro has about 1,200,000 households. A city survey says 38% of households own a dog. Our store customers spend on average $65 a month on our food.
